name: Posuv – Motion Showcase Builder
author: aihubmarket

sections.description:
Posuv is a front-end motion showcase editor. Media and rendering stay in the browser. The free edition includes 24 original motion templates, image and video slots, text and logo layers, background controls, project storage, basic keyframes, PNG snapshots, and WebM export up to 1080p.

Posuv does not send editor media to an external service and does not add tracking.

Posuv Pro is an optional, separately distributed add-on that can add more templates and export capabilities to the shared editor. Posuv Free remains complete and fully usable without it. Learn more at https://aihubmarket.com/posuv/.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the posuv folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP in Plugins.
  2. Activate Posuv.
  3. Open the Posuv page created during activation, or place [posuv_editor] on a page.
sections.faq:
Where are projects stored?

Project settings are stored in local storage and uploaded media is stored in IndexedDB on the current device. This lets supported browsers restore the editor after a tab reload or device sleep without uploading media to a server.

Does export upload my media?

No. Rendering happens locally in the browser.

Does the free edition require an account or licence key?

No. Posuv Free works without an account, licence key, Posuv Pro, or a connection to an AIHubMarket service.
